exposure: induction of labor with vaginal misoprostol
cohort: The study included 88 pregnant women with high-risk, singleton pregnancies at ≥34 weeks gestation, Bishop score ≤6, cephalic presentation, and no contraindications for vaginal misoprostol, who underwent labor induction.
finding: The main indication for cesarean section in this cohort was induction failure, highlighting the importance of protocol review to enhance success rates.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with the number of vaginal misoprostol doses, but there was no statistical difference in the rate of NICU admission between delivery modes.
